Methodology & Criteria

The selection uses 130 monthly reports and 2,811 commercial groupings. September 2026 is partial. Listings, brands and sellers are independent rankings and are not added together. Priority weighs demand, recurrence, ticket, visual impact, cubage, packaging, damage risk, after-sales and regulatory viability. Predictable certification does not exclude an opportunity; it is treated as an entry cost and effort.

Priority A

High demand, strong recurrence and a clear display role. Preference for efficient logistics or strong anchor value.

Priority B

Good opportunity subject to landed-cost, differentiation, packaging, MOQ or certification validation.

Priority C

Catalog extension, niche or item with a less favorable demand/logistics balance.

Next Step

Validate HS/NCM classification, Inmetro/Anatel requirements when applicable, MOQ, packaging, cubage and landed cost in Brazil.
